create_descriptor_pool: create a DescriptorPool instance and add FileDescriptorProto objects to it for dynamic proto type resolution
find_message_type_by_name: find a message type descriptor by its fully qualified name using pool.FindMessageTypeByName()
add_serialized_file: add a serialized FileDescriptorProto bytes string to the pool using pool.AddSerializedFile()
find_extension_by_number: find an extension field descriptor by message descriptor and field number using pool.FindExtensionByNumber()
find_enum_type_by_name: find an enum type descriptor by its fully qualified name using pool.FindEnumTypeByName()
